recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Do not add ValueSet.designation to core unless vocab makes a new explicit decision; future adjustments to alternative title language or preference behavior should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-9121 asked to add designation[0..*] to ValueSet so value-set designers or translators could provide localized or purpose-specific labels for the value set name itself. The Jira status is Published, resolution Persuasive, applied for DSTU2, with the recorded resolution 'already done' and a comment noting that strings are localizable by extension.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-9121-tagged source commit was found. Historical ValueSet designation work predates the issue and concerns concept-level designations, while the current source uses the later ValueSet.title/extension model for the human-facing value-set title.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini and owned by vocab. Current ValueSet.title is marked translatable; ValueSet.compose.include.concept.designation remains the concept-level designation array. Current ValueSet notes say VSD Name maps to ValueSet.title and authors should use valueset-otherTitle when language or preference is needed. The FHIR Extension Pack defines valueset-otherTitle with preferred and language slices, and later tightly related issues FHIR-25395 and FHIR-44727 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because adding top-level ValueSet.designation would be a new resource-model change and is not required by the closed 'already done' Jira decision or by the current implementer guidance.

related_jiras.note: Renamed/created valueset-otherTitle to model human-readable ValueSet titles; already represented on the combined branch.
Added VSD guidance that maps VSD Name to ValueSet.title and valueset-otherTitle.
Added a language element to valueset-otherTitle; already represented on the combined branch.
